name: Zeno Learning
tagline: Gamified learning platform designed around levels, badges, ZenoCoin and referrals
role: Full-stack web platform by the Softwhere team

scenes.title: Social sign-in, referral sign-up
scenes.body: OAuth via Lucia with Google, Facebook and LinkedIn; invite links prefill the referral code.

scenes.title: Pick up where you left off
scenes.body: Course cards come from PostgreSQL via Prisma, with one-tap bookmarks.

scenes.title: Lessons with a reward path
scenes.body: Vidstack player, lesson outline and quiz tab, with a complete-class, finish-quiz, earn-XP path laid out.

scenes.title: Designed for levels, badges, ZenoCoin
scenes.body: Profile UI built around a level gauge, badge grid and RP / ZenoCoin balances; XP and RP stored per learner.

scenes.title: Referral codes, partner list
scenes.body: Each learner gets a unique referral code; sign-ups that use it are linked to the referrer.
